title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: MK-Studios Porto, ORBX Oslo & More!
description:
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for April 26, 2026 is packed with must-have new releases for PC simmers, featuring highly anticipated international airports like Porto and Oslo alongside immersive new regional sceneries you’ll want in your hangar.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 MK-Studios: LPPR Porto Airport (Major European hub with detailed terminal and apron modeling)
🛫 ORBX: Oslo Gardermoen Airport (Norway’s main international gateway brought to life)
🛫 Photorico Scenery: TJSJ San Juan International Airport (Caribbean hub with realistic surroundings)
🛫 FSX3D: LFNA Gap Tallard Airport (Scenic alpine general aviation airport)
🛫 FSX3D: LFMQ Le Castellet Airport (Historic French airfield with motorsport nearby)
🛫 FSX3D: LFKF Figari-Sud-Corse Airport (Beautiful Corsican destination for regional ops)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 DreamScenery: VFR Objects San Francisco region (Enhanced VFR landmarks and objects)
🌆 BravoAirspace: ATG Airline Traffic Global (Improved global airline traffic experience)
🌆 DreamScenery: VFR Objects San Diego region (Detailed landmarks for coastal flying)
🌆 DreamScenery: Cincinnati Enhanced Road Lights FS24 Edition (Improved night lighting immersion)
🌆 DreamScenery: Baltimore Water Fix 2024 Edition (Refined water visuals for the region)
🌆 DreamScenery: KCMH Columbus Airport Lights 2024 Edition (Enhanced airport lighting environment)
🌆 DreamScenery: Alexandria Enhanced Road Lights FS24 Edition (Sharper nighttime road visuals)
🌆 DreamScenery: Abu Dhabi Enhanced Road Lights FS24 Edition (Night flying upgrade for the UAE)
🌆 DreamScenery: New Orleans Night Enhanced 2024 Exclusive (Atmospheric night lighting overhaul)
🌆 CLI4D: Iguazu Falls (Iconic natural landmark recreated in stunning detail)
